title: Linear Search Element Index

content.problemStatement:
Search Element

Write a program to search an element in the given array and print the searched elements index.If no such elements were found print -1.

Note : Print only the first occurrence of search element.
content.inputFormat:
The first line has an integer N denotes the size of the array.

 The second line contains N values separated by space
content.outputFormat: Print the index of the searched element

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Find 0-based index of target element in array.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in toks[1:n+1]]
    target = int(toks[n+1])
    print(arr.index(target) if target in arr else -1)
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Linear search for target element, returning first 0-based index or -1.

hints: Scan array until target is found.
